fccss-second-primary-lung-cancer.name: FCCSS second primary lung cancer risk in childhood cancer survivors

digest.top_line: EORTC 1420 Best-of: no 12-mo MDADI difference, TOS vs DO-IMRT in T1-2 N0-1 OPSCC/SGSCC (+3.9, p=0.326), more mucosal toxicity with RT.
digest.tldr: Randomised TOS vs DO-IMRT in early oropharynx/supraglottis/hypopharynx: 12-mo MDADI adjusted difference +3.9 points (90%CI -2.7 to +10.5; p=0.326), no swallowing difference, more mucosal toxicity with DO-IMRT.
